responsibility: Provides PDP-11 common option handling for CPU/FPU/assembler-mode selection and floating-point defaults. The file maps architecture switches onto the internal target-flag combinations that distinguish 11/10, 11/40, FPU, split I/D, and AC0 behavior, toggles whether named sections are available based on assembler dialect, initializes math-related optimization flags to conservative values, and establishes the default PDP-11 machine configuration consumed by later backend code.
